About

A bit about my journey

sport & strategy

Some of my earliest memories are Saturday and Sunday afternoons parked in front of the TV, watching football or motorsport with my family and all the enthusiasm that comes with it. It is something I still happily carry with me today.

A few years later, I got to do more than watch. Swimming and volleyball gave me the thrill of playing in a team and shaped who I am. Discipline, resilience and the way I handle pressure all started there.

After studying business and economics and entering the professional world, I saw something that had been in my life all along in a new light. I could analyse the sports industry strategically, and the more I learned, the more in awe I was of the entities and the minds behind the storytelling, the competitiveness and the fan connection. That awe led me to a postgraduate degree in Sports Marketing.

Behind every match, someone decides which story gets told.

Today I work in marketing and strategy, with a background in digital performance, product insights and data-driven decisions.

Academic project · Postgraduate in Sports Marketing & Entertainment · IPAM · 2025/26

Marketing Plan: AC Milan

A complete plan for a club in transition: a strong brand and room to grow, but dependent on structural investment and an integrated strategy that turns fan engagement into economic value.

Four strategic objectives

  • Fan engagement and relationship: more digital interaction and a stronger community
  • International growth: a bigger fan base outside Italy
  • Monetisation: more revenue per fan and more diverse revenue
  • Brand and positioning: a global entertainment brand

Five strategic options

  • Digital-first: continuous multiplatform content, short video, own platforms (app, OTT) and fan data
  • Internationalisation: the US, Asia and the Middle East, with local partnerships, tours and academies
  • Experience: matchday, premium and hospitality, hybrid events and brand activations
  • Monetisation and diversification: global e-commerce, premium content, memberships and licensing
  • Data-driven: centralised CRM, audience segmentation and personalised communication

From strategy to execution

A seven-stage fan journey (discovery, interest, engagement, purchase, matchday, loyalty and recommendation) links each objective to concrete actions. Every stage has fan goals, touchpoints and KPIs, from reach and engagement rate to conversion, revenue per fan, retention and NPS, with the departments responsible for each.

Marketing mix

The club as a media and entertainment producer: a hybrid product (match, media content, cultural identity and lifestyle), dynamic, premium and accessible pricing, omnichannel distribution, and continuous emotional storytelling with creators and global campaigns.

Illustrative budget

A high-level estimate of about €28.5M across digital transformation, fan engagement, matchday experience, international expansion, lifestyle and sustainability, built from the club's 2024/25 annual report. It is an academic exercise, not a real budget.
